title.ja: 右四間飛車の６筋と角の退路を読む
title.en: Reading the sixth file and bishop escapes against Right Fourth File Rook

intro.ja: 後手の飛車が６二に回ると、６筋の歩交換に銀や桂が加わることがあります。四間飛車側は角を狙う桂を見落とさず、６五の取り合いで実際に利く駒を数えます。囲いに一手使えるかどうかも、目の前の脅威で判断します。
intro.en: With Gote's rook on 6b, a pawn clash on the sixth file may gain silver or knight support. From the Fourth File Rook side, notice when a knight attacks the bishop and count the pieces that can actually recapture on 6e. The immediate threats also decide whether there is time to improve the castle.

question.ja: 後手６二飛・７四銀・６四歩に対し、先手５六銀・６六歩・６八飛が並ぶ局面。△６五歩▲同銀と歩を取ると△同銀のあと、先手は何で銀を取り返せますか？
question.en: Against Gote R6b, S7d and P6d, Sente has S5f, P6f and R6h. After P6e, Sx6e and Gote's Sx6e, which Sente piece can recapture the silver?

answer.ja: ６六の歩が６五へ進んで銀を取れます。６六が空くので６八飛も６五の歩を縦に守ります。ただし後手が銀で取ることは選択肢の一つです。
answer.en: The pawn on 6f captures the silver on 6e. This vacates 6f, allowing the rook on 6h to support the pawn along the file. Gote's silver capture is only one possible reply.

title.ja: 桂に追われた角で飛車を見返す
title.en: Escape the knight while looking back at the rook

text.ja: 後手８五桂は７七角を次に取れます。先手は２八玉・３八銀・４九金の片美濃で、６九金を５八へ寄せる手もありますが、まず角の退路が必要です。９五へ行くには８六が空いています。
text.en: Gote's knight on 8e can capture the bishop on 7g next. Sente has a Half Mino with K2h, S3h and G4i, and could move G6i toward 5h later. First the bishop needs an escape; 8f is clear on its route to 9e.

text.ja: ▲９五角は桂の利きから外れ、８四・７三が空いているため６二飛まで斜めに利きます。後手の飛車が動けば角の利きも変わります。角を逃げたことと、飛車を取れることを同一視しません。
text.en: B9e leaves the knight's target. With 8d and 7c clear, the bishop also points along the diagonal to Gote's rook on 6b. Gote can move the rook, so this is pressure on the rook rather than a guaranteed capture.

text.ja: 後手が△６一飛と引いた例では、先手角が６二を通って６一飛を取る斜線はありません。角を守る一手に後手も飛車を動かしましたが、次の６筋の歩の接触を別に読む必要があります。
text.en: In the sample R6a retreat, the bishop no longer attacks the rook: its diagonal reaches 6b, not 6a. Sente saved the bishop and made Gote spend a rook move, but the coming sixth-file pawn contact still needs its own calculation.

text.ja: ここで先に▲５八金と囲いを進めると、△７七桂成で角を取られます。６九金を５八へ動かすこと自体は自然でも、７七角が桂で取られる局面では順番が逆です。
text.en: If Sente improves the castle with G5h first, Nx7g+ captures the bishop. Moving the gold from 6i to 5h is a normal castle move, but the attacked bishop makes that move order costly here.

title.ja: 銀が６五を守るなら歩で受ける
title.en: Use the pawn when the silver covers 6e

text.ja: 後手飛車は６二、歩は６四ですが、銀は３三で６五へは利いていません。先手５六銀は６五を前斜めに守り、６八飛は６筋の後方にいます。この配置で△６五歩が来た場合を数えます。
text.en: Gote has R6b and P6d, but its silver on 3c does not cover 6e. Sente's silver on 5f does cover 6e, with R6h behind the sixth-file pawn. Count the exchange if Gote pushes P6e.

text.ja: △６五歩には▲同歩。先手歩が６五へ進み、５六銀がその歩を守ります。後手６二飛は６三・６四が空いた縦道から６五へ出られますが、飛車で歩を取れば先手銀が飛車を取り返せます。
text.en: After P6e, Sente recaptures with Px6e. S5f protects the pawn now on 6e. Gote's rook has a clear vertical path from 6b to 6e, but taking the pawn with the rook would let S5f recapture that rook.

text.ja: 後手が別の手△８四歩を選ぶ例では、▲６六飛と浮いて６五歩の後ろへ飛車を近づけられます。６五歩の得だけで形勢を決めず、後手の８筋の伸びと自玉の囲いも比べます。
text.en: If Gote instead plays the sample P8d, Sente can float to R6f behind P6e. R6h already supported P6e along the open file, so the float only brings the rook closer. Winning the pawn contact alone does not settle the position; Gote's eighth-file play and Sente's shelter still matter.

text.ja: 後手が△６五飛で歩を取る枝なら▲同銀で飛車を取れます。これは後手の選択した交換の結果であり、後手が飛車を差し出す義務はありません。
text.en: In the branch where Gote chooses Rx6e, Sx6e captures the rook. This demonstrates the silver's coverage of 6e, not a forced rook loss: Gote can decline that exchange.

title.ja: ７四銀が加わっても数えて歩で取る
title.en: Count again when the 7d silver joins in, still taking with the pawn

text.ja: 今度は後手７四銀も６五へ利いています。△６五歩のあとの６五に、後手は７四銀と６二飛の二枚、先手は５六銀と、６六歩が進んだあとの６八飛の二枚で取り返せます。数が同じでも最後に取るのは先手です。
text.en: Gote's S7d now also controls 6e. After P6e, Gote has two capturers on 6e (S7d and R6b) and Sente has two recapturers (S5f and, once the pawn on 6f has advanced, R6h). The counts are equal, but Sente makes the last capture.

text.ja: △６五歩には、この形でも▲同歩です。６六が空くので６八飛が６五の歩を縦に守り、５六銀と合わせて二枚で支えます。銀に取り返される心配から▲同銀を選ぶ必要はありません。
text.en: Even here, Px6e is the recapture. Vacating 6f lets R6h defend the pawn on 6e along the file, so S5f and the rook give two supports. Fear of Gote's silver does not force Sente to recapture with the silver.

text.ja: 後手が△同銀と取る例なら、▲同銀で銀を取り返します。後手には６二飛が残りますが、６五へ取りに行くと先手の飛車が取り返します。この例は後手が銀交換を選んだ場合で、必然の応手ではありません。
text.en: If Gote chooses Sx6e, Sx6e recaptures the silver. Gote's rook on 6b remains, but taking on 6e would let Sente's rook recapture. This is the branch where Gote chooses the silver trade; it is not a forced reply.

text.ja: ▲同銀と取る手もあり、取り合いの数は崩れません。ただし銀を前へ出すので、５六に銀を残したまま歩で取る手より評価は低く、この教材では歩で取る形を基準にします。
text.en: Sx6e is also playable and the count does not break. It puts the silver forward, though, and the engine rates it lower than the pawn recapture that keeps S5f at home, so this lesson takes the pawn recapture as the baseline.

text.ja: 銀交換の直後に後手が△６五飛で歩を取るなら、▲同飛で後手飛車を取れます。６七が空いて６八飛の縦道が通っています。後手には別の応手があるため、この枝を必然の飛車取りとは考えません。
text.en: If Gote immediately chooses Rx6e after the silver exchange, Sente's rook on 6h captures it with Rx6e. 6g is clear along that file. Gote can choose another reply, so this is a conditional warning against that rook capture.
